# Copilot Instructions for ROSground

- **Stack & entry**: Expo-managed React Native (React 19, RN 0.81). Navigation and theming are wired in [App.js](App.js); app wraps screens with [src/context/AdConsentContext.js](src/context/AdConsentContext.js) then [src/context/ROSContext.js](src/context/ROSContext.js).
- **ROS bridge plumbing**: WebSocket lifecycle, topic subscriptions, rosapi discovery, and publish/advertise helpers live in [src/context/ROSContext.js](src/context/ROSContext.js). Always go through `useROS()` instead of opening sockets in screens; connection state is kept in `connectionInfo` and `subscribedTopics`.
- **Topic handling**: Incoming messages with `topic`/`msg` mutate `subscribedTopics` in place. `discoverTopics()` calls `/rosapi/topics`; `getTopicType()` calls `/rosapi/topic_type` with a temporary message listener—remove or reuse it rather than duplicating service wiring.
- **Screen flow**: Connect -> Dashboard -> TopicBrowser/Publish. Navigators are defined in [App.js](App.js) via native stack; most headers are hidden in-screen.
- **Connect screen**: [src/screens/ConnectScreen.js](src/screens/ConnectScreen.js) collects IP/ports and calls `connectToROS`; dev mode (Expo or __DEV__) allows skipping validation. Defaults point to a local LAN robot.
- **Dashboard**: [src/screens/DashboardScreen.js](src/screens/DashboardScreen.js) shows connection badge, video, and topic widgets. In dev mode with no subscriptions it renders `mockTopics` for layout. Landscape view moves actions to the header and renders topics horizontally.
- **Topic browser**: [src/screens/TopicBrowserScreen.js](src/screens/TopicBrowserScreen.js) auto-loads topics via `discoverTopics()` when connected. Selecting a topic triggers `getTopicType()`; manual entry requires both name and type. Keep list mutations filtered through `availableTopics` and `filteredTopics` state.
- **Publishing**: [src/screens/PublishScreen.js](src/screens/PublishScreen.js) requires `advertiseTopic()` before `publishMessage()`, and enforces JSON parsing of `rawMessage`. Call `unadvertiseTopic()` on close or when toggling off.
- **Video stream**: [src/components/VideoPanel.js](src/components/VideoPanel.js) builds MJPEG URL `http://<ip>:<videoPort>/stream`; empty state shows a "Not Available" badge. The helper bridge for ROS2 images to MJPEG is [video__http_server.py](video__http_server.py).
- **Ads & consent**: Consent boot and status live in [src/context/AdConsentContext.js](src/context/AdConsentContext.js) using `react-native-google-mobile-ads`. `AdBanner` ([src/components/AdBanner.js](src/components/AdBanner.js)) uses TestIds in dev; prod unit IDs are blank—wire them from env config ([src/config/adshelper.js](src/config/adshelper.js)) and guard on `canShowAds`/`canShowPersonalizedAds`.
- **Styling**: Dark palette centralized in [src/theme/colors.js](src/theme/colors.js). Reuse `theme` tokens for backgrounds, borders, and text; inputs and cards expect those colors.
- **State updates**: WebSocket message handler mutates topics by topic name; avoid creating parallel state for ROS messages. Use `unsubscribeFromTopic()` to keep local state and server subscription in sync.
- **Error handling**: `connectToROS` rejects on socket error; upstream screens show inline error text. `TopicBrowser` guards actions when `isConnected` is false; preserve those UX checks when refactoring.
- **Build/run**: Install with `npm install`. Dev server: `npx expo start` (or `npm run start`). Native builds: `npm run android` / `npm run ios` (after `npx expo prebuild` if using custom native). Web via `npm run web`.
- **Testing hooks**: No automated tests; manual validation relies on a running rosbridge server (default 9090) and optional MJPEG stream (default 8080). Keep mock data paths for UI sanity in dev.
- **Network assumptions**: Device and robot on same LAN; rosapi services must be available for topic discovery/type lookups. Video stream endpoints must allow `multipart/x-mixed-replace` MJPEG.
- **New features**: Prefer adding ROS interactions as helpers inside [src/context/ROSContext.js](src/context/ROSContext.js) so all screens share connection state. Keep navigation additions registered in [App.js](App.js) and mirror styling tokens.
- **Caution**: `AdBanner` currently returns an empty placeholder if no unit ID—ensure ad IDs are set before expecting revenue. Python bridge script imports `rxlpy` (typo for `rclpy`); fix before deployment if using it.
